use: src/data/localPortraits.js via src/ui/portraitArt.js: the face of a procedural station-bar contact (not authored cast). One pool per role; a local gets one face from its station and bar slot.
generator: OpenAI image generation via codex exec -m gpt-5.5 (ChatGPT account); tools/art/imagegen_variants.py (3 variants per two-person sheet, each taken from its own session folder), best chosen per person by review, cut by tools/art/cut_portraits.py (768 px square JPEG, quality 90)
license: Generated for SpaceFace by the project. Two existing portraits (portrait_kessler, portrait_rook) were given as look references only. Every face is an invented person; no real person or third-party photograph was supplied.
briefs: tools/art/local_portrait_briefs.py holds the shared style frame and each person's brief (a specific life, a justified detail, the capture device)

barkeep_01.jpg.subject: a woman of about 58, broad-shouldered, a silver-streaked braid, an old pale steam-tap burn scar across her left forearm from decades behind the taps, a worn canvas apron over a thermal shirt, one hand polishing a steel cup; captured by the bar's own cheap overhead security camera, slightly wide-angle, warm tungsten.

barkeep_02.jpg.subject: a man of about 44, South Asian, round face, close beard with early grey, rolled sleeves, a bar towel on his shoulder and a bent stylus behind his ear; captured on the cracked glass of a tip-jar payment terminal camera, low angle, cool screen light.

barkeep_03.jpg.subject: a man of about 66, very dark skin, white close-cropped hair, thick-framed old reading lenses on a cord, a patched cardigan over a work shirt, kind tired eyes; captured by a dusty ceiling dome camera above the back shelf, flat greenish fluorescent light.

barkeep_04.jpg.subject: a woman of about 36, East Asian, a sharp bob with one dyed-orange streak, a rubber glove on one hand, a laminated drinks list pinned to her apron, wary amused expression; captured by the bar's tablet-menu front camera, slightly oversharpened.

barkeep_05.jpg.subject: a man of about 52, white, bald with a heavy brow, a prosthetic left hand of dull steel holding a glass, a faded work-crew jacket, deliberate calm; captured by the till's receipt-printer camera, grainy and warm.
